newsitem.title: UK: Williams pleased with current performance.
newsitem.headline: Williams pleased with current performance.

text.p: International manufacturing group Williams Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it was pleased overall with its performance to date in the second half.

In a trading update, the company said its performance was in line with the outlook given at the time of its half-year results. It said favourable conditions had prevailed in the U.S. and some improvement had ocurred in the UK, but European markets remained difficult.
The company said management efforts had overcome much of the effects of the strength of sterling, but a continuation of this strength would present additional challenges.
